edits.before:
Mkakati mkuu: Huchukulia chakula, wafanyakazi, kuzaliwa, mafunzo, ujenzi na mapigano kuwa mahitaji yanayoshindana. Hupanga ukubwa wa jeshi kwa sehemu kulingana na makadirio ya nguvu ya adui, kisha hujaribu kulifikisha kwa ufanisi.

Uchumi na maendeleo: Hupanga kuzaliwa kulingana na chakula na nguvu kazi, hudumisha fursa za muda bila kazi kwa mafunzo, na huacha kuongeza wafanyakazi wa ziada uzalishaji wa jeshi unapohitajika. Hupanua uwezo wa mafunzo na huepuka kufunga miundombinu mingi kwa maboresho kwa wakati mmoja.

Uchunguzi na maamuzi: Hukadiria jeshi la adui kutokana na viumbe wanaoonekana na kumbukumbu za walioonekana, kwa kutumia modeli iliyofunzwa. Malengo hutegemea thamani, umbali, minara, wafanyakazi walio wazi na udumifu. Misheni za matunda husaidia aina mbalimbali za chakula na kuvutia viumbe wahamie.

Mashambulizi na ulinzi: Huweka mashujaa akiba kwa mafunzo na ulinzi, kisha hukusanya jeshi la ardhini linalostahiki karibu na miundombinu rafiki ya chakula kabla ya kutuma mawimbi. Huitikia vitisho vya karibu na kutathmini njia za kuingia makazini.

Mashambulizi yanapokwama: Baada ya kushindwa kufikisha wimbi mara nne mfululizo, hubadili kwenda bendera za mashambulizi zinazoimarishwa daima. Mashambulizi ya kuvuka maji pia yanaweza kutumia uimarishaji endelevu. Njia hii ya ziada haitatui kila kizuizi kabla mkusanyiko haujaweza kuundwa.

Ikilinganishwa na AI nyingine: Huunganisha chakula, mafunzo, taarifa za uchunguzi na upelekaji wa jeshi kwa karibu zaidi. Cabino husisitiza mashambulizi kadhaa ya majengo; Maxima husisitiza makadirio ya mahitaji na kufikisha majeshi yaliyokusanywa.

Nguvu na udhaifu: Hudumisha ukuaji na kujaza jeshi huku ikibadilika kulingana na shinikizo la chakula na vitisho vinavyoonekana. Inahitaji chakula, nafasi za mafunzo na eneo wazi la kukusanyika; msongamano na njia ndefu vinaweza kuzuia kufika.

Mbinu za kujaribu dhidi yake: Gombea vyanzo vya chakula vilivyo wazi, nyumba za wageni na kambi za jeshi kabla mawimbi hayajakusanyika. Dumisha jeshi la ulinzi lililo pamoja na lenye mahitaji, na vuruga njia za uimarishaji. Tarajia shinikizo linalorudiwa baada ya wimbi la kwanza.

Uchunguzi: Makadirio ya jeshi hutumia walioonekana na historia ya uchunguzi, si jumla iliyofichwa ya wanajeshi wa adui.

edits.rationale: A supplied defense has adequate food/equipment; idle training opportunities and reinforcing flags/assaults mean available time and additional forces, not unmet needs or flag upgrades.
Sandbar is a sand deposit/fungu la mchanga, not threshold or barrier; preserve singular/plural concord across controls and errors.
Playa is a dry salt lake basin, not any salt lake.

editor_notes: Supplied defensiveforce has food/equipment, not unmetneeds; reinforcement means sending addedforces, not upgrading flags themselves.
Friendlyfoodinfra on itsownside, not personallyfriendly; training uses idleopportunities without requiring literal unusedtimeobjects.

Sandbars consistent mafungu ya mchanga, Playa explicitly drysaltylake, Bajada footmountain sedimentplains and fans clearly fan-shaped deposits. Descriptive terms do not claim primarynative technicalcertification.
Portagedepth is forestplug thickness to cut through (actualPortageLakesGenerator.cpp:690-728), not waterdepth or opaque dryroaddepth.
Savefailure preserves edits ineditor, not literal openedchanges.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
